infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Reherza listens while you rehearse so it can tell when your line ends, check your words against the script, and score your delivery. Audio is captured only on your turn.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Reherza records your self-tapes with the camera in the Studio. Recording starts only when you tap the red button.
